authority: Research inputs and cross-model hypotheses only. Nothing in this registry is an accepted vehicle signal definition.

sources.scope: Exact-model-year Toyota owner manual identifying 1GR-FE and 2UZ-FE 2005 4Runner configurations.
sources.limitations: Configuration applicability only; it does not disclose raw CAN identifiers, payload definitions, or diagnostic PID support.

sources.publisher: Toyota General 2005 Features content; archived on Scribd
sources.scope: Exact-model-year Toyota manual section documenting a 500 kbit/s 2005 4Runner/Tundra CAN topology and a contrasting Sequoia topology.
sources.limitations: Toyota-authored content on an unversioned third-party mirror; topology only, with no raw CAN identifier or payload definition.

sources.publisher: Toyota GSIC manual content; archived by ToyotaManuals on GitLab
sources.scope: Adjacent-model-year 4Runner GRN210/215 and UZN210/215 repair/new-features manual with CAN VIM/BUS CHECK and independent accelerator-channel references.
sources.limitations: Toyota-authored content is served by a third-party archive; it establishes service-tool observables and topology, not raw broadcast-CAN layouts.

sources.publisher: Toyota New Features manual content; archived by ToyotaManuals
sources.scope: Related Land Cruiser/Prado VSC CAN topology, participating nodes, and 500 kbit/s communication speed.
sources.limitations: Related-SUV topology only; no exact 2005 4Runner identifier, payload, scale, or ECU-software equivalence.

sources.scope: Standard emissions-related diagnostic services, message behavior, timing, and reference to PID definitions in the Digital Annex.
sources.limitations: The exact historical revision and Digital Annex must be selected and licensed; applicability must be verified for the exact vehicle, engine, model year, and region.

sources.scope: Toyota model/year service, repair, wiring, and diagnostic information.
sources.limitations: Subscription content; does not itself provide a redistributable exact raw CAN DBC.

sources.scope: Independent physical-measurement correlation of 11-bit, 500 kbit/s CAN on a 2010 Toyota Camry.
sources.limitations: Cross-model research only; no 2005 4Runner byte-layout, scale, unit, or applicability guarantee.

sources.publisher: SAE International / Ruth, Bartlett, and Daily
sources.scope: Peer-reviewed synchronized Camry testing that identifies 0x2C1 accelerator-pedal traffic and 0x2C4 engine-speed traffic on an 11-bit, 500 kbit/s CAN network and reports their update behavior.
sources.limitations: One Camry family only; no exact 2005 4Runner byte-layout, scale, unit, ECU-calibration, or applicability guarantee.

sources.scope: Open DBC parsing, replay, CAN comparison, and vehicle-port workflow.
sources.limitations: No accepted exact 2005 4Runner signal pack was established for this project during this review.

sources.scope: Community mapping labeled for a 2012 Toyota FJ Cruiser and useful for related-platform field and scaling hypotheses.
sources.limitations: Later model year, community-maintained artifact, and no exact 2005 4Runner applicability proof.
Community artifact with no exact 2005 4Runner applicability proof and no license shown for importing its definitions.
Community artifact; model year and exact target applicability are not established.

sources.scope: Pinned Lexus IS F definitions for 0x025, 0x0B0, 0x0B2, 0x0B4, 0x224, 0x2C1, and 0x2C4.
sources.limitations: Community artifact; model year and exact target applicability are not established. Its pressure and temperature transforms conflict with other sources.

sources.scope: Peer-reviewed 2010 Camry transmitter-fingerprinting study with separate ground truth; groups 0x223 and 0x224 on one ECU and separates 0x2C1 and 0x2C4 transmitters.
sources.limitations: Transmitter grouping is not payload-semantic or target-applicability proof.

sources.scope: Primary 2010 Lexus IS250 experiment correlating synchronized physical references and DLC CAN data; identifies RPM-related 0x2C4/0x2D0 behavior and one-indexed byte 7 of 0x2C1 as pedal-related.
sources.limitations: Cross-model evidence only. It does not establish target scaling, the FJ 0x2D0 turbine transform, or a universal selector/gear byte.

sources.scope: Listen-only Yaris notes identifying a 0x2C4 engine-revolution field and candidate wheel/brake identifiers.
sources.limitations: The author explicitly calls the fields guessed; model year, scale, and target applicability are not established.

sources.scope: OEM Techstream snapshot procedure listing independent drivability values including engine, accelerator, temperature, output-axis, NT-speed, selector, and lockup data.
sources.limitations: Diagnostic-value availability does not establish raw broadcast-CAN identifiers or fields.

sources.scope: Official Toyota production grouping for 4Runner, Land Cruiser Prado, LC200, Lexus GX, and FJ Cruiser research cohorts.
sources.limitations: A production relationship does not prove common ECUs, calibrations, network topology, or CAN signal definitions.

sources.scope: Vendor-published production-vehicle ECU protocol and connection catalog.
sources.limitations: No exact 2005 4Runner entry was established in this review.
